h:
这是一个示例工作流程预算毛茸茸的速度。下载并解压存档，然后打开BudgetFurrySpeedWorkflow.jsonComfyUI 中的文件。您可以将其拖放到 ComfyUI 窗口中以加载它。

该工作流程展示了一个简单的文本到图像过程，具有两个高级通道。连接所需的采样器和大小，然后将预览节点静音和取消静音以控制生成的内容。

它面向初学者，隐藏了 ComfyUI 的大部分复杂性和选项。

示例

黑赤壁猫的示例图像是使用工作流程中包含的默认提示生成的原始生成图像。唯一的例外是删除一张图像中的假水印。

o.en:
This is an example workflow forBudgetFurry Speed. Download and unzip the archive, then open theBudgetFurrySpeedWorkflow.jsonfile in ComfyUI. You can drop it in the ComfyUI window to load it.

The workflow showcases a simple text-to-image process with two upscale passes. Connect the desired sampler and size, then mute and unmute preview nodes to control what gets generated.

It is aimed at beginners, hiding most of the complexity and options of ComfyUI.

Examples

The example images of the black chibi cat are raw generations made with the default prompt included in the workflow. The sole exception is the removal of a fake watermark in one image.
